## About
Kingdom Auto Glass is a small, local auto glass business in Hugo, owned by Ariana and Chris. Ariana is usually the voice on the phone, answering questions and getting you scheduled. Chris does the glass work.
We replace windshields and handle auto glass repair, and we try to put every car back together exactly the way it came to us. Customers have given us a 5 rating across 190 Google reviews, and we're grateful to every one of them.

## Services
- Windshield replacement: We remove the damaged windshield and install a new one, taking care not to damage anything around it.
- Auto glass repair: Repair work for your vehicle's glass, from the same team that handles replacements.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my insurance?
A: One reviewer said we got on the phone with their insurance and scheduled the new windshield install for them. Call us and we'll talk through your situation.

Q: Do you match prices?
A: One customer said we matched a major brand's price and actually beat it for them. Ask us when you call.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
